10-supplemental_gsea_plots



library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(enrichplot)






# 10.1. Import data


results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

rna_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "DE_limma_results_transcriptome.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

# Use gene symbols and log2FC
gsea_df <- rna_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) %>%
  distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all=T)

# Named numeric vector: log2FC, names = gene symbols
gene_ranks <- gsea_df$log2FoldChange
names(gene_ranks) <- gsea_df$gene_symbol

# Sort decreasing
gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing=T)

hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(
  species  = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

set.seed(8634782)
gsea_hallmark <- GSEA(
  geneList     = gene_ranks,
  TERM2GENE    = hallmark_sets,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  eps          = 0,
  verbose      = FALSE
)






# 10.2. Supplemental Hallmark Pathways


pathways <- c(
  "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING",
  "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
  "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",
  "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
  "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS",
  "HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING",
  "HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT"
)


pathway_titles <- c(
  "Hallmark IL6 JAK STAT3 Signaling",
  "Hallmark Inflammatory Response",
  "Hallmark Allograft Rejection",
  "Hallmark TNFA Signaling via NFKB",
  "Hallmark Apoptosis",
  "Hallmark IL2 STAT5 Signaling",
  "Hallmark Complement"
)


for (i in seq_along(pathways)) {

  p <- gseaplot2(
    gsea_hallmark,
    geneSetID = pathways[i],
    title = pathway_titles[i],
    base_size = 12,
    subplots = c(1, 2, 3)
  )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0(
        "GSEA_",
        pathways[i],
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 7,
    height = 6
  )
}
